entities.summary: Bertrand Edward Dawson, 1st Viscount Dawson of Penn, was a physician to the British royal family and President of the Royal College of Physicians from 1931 to 1937. He is known for his responsibility in the death of George V, who under his care was injected with a fatal dose of cocaine and morphine to hasten his death.
